reason: $325 is a lot for a toddler's party on $38k, and I still have to buy the cake. I can do a park pavilion or the house for under $100 and the kids won't know the difference.
objection: $325 for two hours, plus the cake, when a toddler won't remember any of it and we're stretched already.
would_change_my_mind: A basic party at around $175 to $200, or a weekday slot at a real discount.
